ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by dominant low-intensity pixels with dispersed high-intensity white mottling; right lobe is characterized by dominant high-intensity white pixels with irregular low-intensity dark spots concentrated towards the trailing edge and midline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree angle and a moderate pixel-depth depression relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; left lobe displays larger, more jagged peaks/valleys, while the right lobe shows more consistent, smaller sawtooth-like variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curve trajectory extending from the median notch to the upward-curling distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast yellow and white circular pixel groups (barnacles/scarring) positioned on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible across the dark pigmentation of the left lobe; dark linear markings visible on the white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical degradation and irregular pixel-level trauma evident on the extreme margins of the fluke tips, consistent with localized parasitic or external surface attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Strong pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right lobes.
